title: Guitare et Partition sur Gueridon
medium: Pochoir in color on Wove paper with margins

events.n: publisher ("he": Paul Rosenberg, Picasso's dealer); early 1920s; set of 10 pochoirs after gouaches of 1920
events.q: In the early 1920s he published a set of 10 pochoirs, including the current work, after a series of cubist gouaches depicting still life and Commedia dell' Arte motifs that Picasso had made in 1920
Picasso worked closely with the professional pochoir printmakers to replicate the colors and compositions of his early gouaches, then signed each of the pochoirs in pencil.

sources.name: Rachael Cozad Fine Art, on Artsy
